Disappointed with the Battery
The machine itself works reasonably well and does a decent job of cutting grass. However, I found some serious issues with the battery and the included accessories.

The seller claims that the battery is 48V. However, after opening the battery pack, I found that it contains only five small 4V batteries/cells, which adds up to just 20V, not 48V.

In addition, two batteries were provided, and one of them was completely damaged and unusable.

The nut opener is also missing from the package.

Overall, the machine itself cuts grass fairly well, but the misleading battery specification, damaged battery, and missing accessory are major disappointments. I expected the product to match the specifications provided by the seller and to arrive with all the necessary accessories.

Completely ineffective
I purchased this indigo powder specifically to turn my hair from henna-red to black. I followed the usual two-step process: first applying henna and then applying indigo over it.

Even after keeping the indigo on my hair for around 2 hours, there was practically no change in color. My hair remained red from the henna instead of turning dark brown or black.

I have used the henna-and-indigo method before, so I know what kind of result genuine indigo normally gives. Based on my experience with this product, I seriously doubt its purity or quality. It may be old, ineffective, or mixed with something else.

Very disappointing experience and a complete waste of time and money. I would not recommend this product for anyone buying it to cover grey/red henna-treated hair and achieve a black color.
